# The Women’s Collective

> A community for women building businesses, careers, creative work, and real relationships close to home in Western Queens. Find your people, share what you do, and help someone else shine.

The collective is for women in Queens who are building something — a business, a career, a creative practice. Founders, freelancers, makers, and the newly curious are all welcome. Neighborhoods: Long Island City, Astoria, Sunnyside, Woodside, Jackson Heights, Elmhurst, East Elmhurst, Forest Hills, Rego Park, and surrounding Queens neighborhoods.

Membership is by application, and a real person in Queens reads every one. Approval brings a catalogue number, the chance to save a seat at member gatherings, and the choice to show a card in the member directory. Gatherings include coffee introductions, supper clubs and headshot days across Queens. The collective does not sell access to its members; partners host, teach, supply or support gatherings.

The founder is Nataša Tuohy, a New York–based architectural and interior designer with a studio in Greenpoint.

## Membership

### Who is the collective for?

Women in Queens who are building something — a business, a career, a creative practice — and want real relationships close to home. Founders, freelancers, makers, and the newly curious are all welcome. No follower count or pitch deck required.

### Which neighborhoods are included?

Long Island City, Astoria, Sunnyside, Woodside, Jackson Heights, Elmhurst, East Elmhurst, Forest Hills, Rego Park, and surrounding Queens neighborhoods.

### Is the community inclusive?

Yes. We welcome women from all backgrounds, including moms, married and single women, LGBTQ+ members, non-binary people who feel aligned with the community, immigrants, international members, and people from diverse cultures.

### What happens after I apply?

A real person in Queens reads every application. We’ll be in touch by email about next steps.

### Can I create an account before I’m approved?

Yes. Create your login now; your profile unlocks once the collective approves your application.

## Your profile

### Who can see my profile?

You decide. Turn on “Show me in the member directory” and other members can see your card. Turn on “Show my profile on the public website” as well and anyone can see it on our homepage and member page. Neither goes live until you’re approved.

### When do I get my catalogue number?

It’s assigned once you’re approved.

### Can I change my card later?

Any time, from your account page. Short and warm beats long and formal.

## Headshots

### Do I need an official headshot?

Only if you’re approved for the public member directory. Directory portraits come from a session with the collective’s official photographer, so every card feels consistent. Personal or previously taken headshots cannot be used.

## Gatherings

### Who can come to gatherings?

Approved members save a seat from their account.

### Can I host or sponsor one?

We’d love that. Tell us on your application, or [get in touch](https://new.thewomenscollective.club/contact).

## Privacy

### What do you do with my information?

We use it to review applications, keep in touch, run programs and events, schedule headshots, and — only with your permission — create directory listings and spotlights. Private information is not intentionally published.
